approval_case.title: Send an AKS product failure to its owner first
approval_case.situation: One current AKS validation failed. The project owner has the trace but has not investigated or tried recovery. No human-only decision exists.
approval_case.hao_request: The evaluator proposes asking Hao what to do.
approval_case.correct_behavior: Route the failure to the AKS project owner and keep it out of Hao's inbox. Require the owner to diagnose the cause, attempt the bounded recovery, and return a passing rerun or a precise blocker. May follows the work and escalates only if a real human authority decision remains.
